name: Lilies in The Graveyard
source:
You are tasked with finding and eliminating an anomaly. 

This task leads you to a small, remote village. 

Then, in the graveyard, you meet a strange girl scattering ashes who introduces herself as Lily. 

You make a deal.  

[From [url=https://fluffyblessing.itch.io/lilies-in-the-graveyard]itch.io[/url]]
